'''Domm ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] criminal living inside the [[Greenwood Station]] dome on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]].

==Biography==
Domm was a business contact of the criminal [[Tre Sana]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked out of [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. His face was scarred from a hard life of illegal work, and he smelled of chemical intoxicants. His father was [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] by a [[Je'daii]] during the [[Despot War]] at the [[Battle of Tython|battle]] at [[Kaleth]]. In [[25,793 BBY]] he was visited by Sana and the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]], who pressed him for information regarding the location of [[Maxhagan]]. Lanoree Brock used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to sense his intentions and to draw the info they needed from his mind. Getting directed to [[District Six]] of Greenwood Station, Brock pulled flecks of skin dust from the floor up into Domm's nostrils and to his brain. Employing [[Alchemy of flesh|alchemy of the flesh]] to meld the skin flakes into Domm's brain, she was able to erase Domm's memory after the encounter so that he would not report on them. Brock couldn't be sure how long her alchemy would last, but for a time Domm wouldn't remember his own name.<ref name="Into the Void" />
